panels.title: Open unowned drift
panels.description: Unresolved drift records from real observations with no matching preregistered change. This counts records, not failed devices. Unowned does not prove a change was unauthorized.

panels.title: Open exercise drift

panels.title: Exercise drift history
panels.description: All unowned exercise records, including resolved records and rollbacks. Three changes plus three rollbacks produce six records; these do not count toward real drift acceptance.

options.content:
[Open configuration management: backups, comparison & recovery ↗](http://192.168.20.169:8080/config/ui?lang=en)

**Open unowned drift**: unresolved real-observation records without a matching preregistered change. **Open exercise drift**: simulated records under the same conditions.

**Exercise history** includes resolved records and rollbacks: 3 changes + 3 rollbacks = 6 records. **Backup failures** counts devices whose latest attempt failed; unchanged configurations are successful backups.

Covers lab devices with backup attempts; daily backup time, timezone and devices are configurable. Unowned does not prove unauthorized activity. Missing data is not zero. Cards show state at the selected end time; history is not the number of new records within the selected range.
